scope: RTX3 texture payload census in the prepared disc workspace

header.gs_tex0: u64le@8; observed PSM/TW/TH decode agrees with dimension fields
header.dimensions: u16le width,height @0x20; powers of two observed
header.pixel_bytes: u32le@0x24; equals dimensions times PSM bits per pixel
header.palette: trailing 16-entry/64-byte or 256-entry/1024-byte CLUT for indexed modes

capabilities.indexed_palette: Preserved; imported pixels map to nearest existing palette color
capabilities.canvas_growth: Unsupported; replacement dimensions must match the source
capabilities.high_bit_psm: PSMT8H, PSMT4HL, and PSMT4HH are exported/imported as compact indexed RTX3 pixels in linear order using the existing CLUT/alpha path. The GS manual describes their bit lanes in PSMCT32 GS memory; three game samples render coherent previews, but RTX3 storage and runtime sampling are not proved by that hardware description.
capabilities.indexed_pixel_layout: Current editable candidate: indexed pixel values remain in compact RTX3 linear byte order; PSMT8 CLUT indices use the observed map, and PSMT4-family CLUT order is unchanged. Controlled 10+10 PSMT4/PSMT8 image matrix plus three coherent high-bit sample previews; not a full runtime/rendering proof.
capabilities.indexed_alpha: Expand the PS2 GS 0..128 alpha range to 8-bit TGA with min(255, alpha*2); zero remains transparent and 128 becomes opaque.
capabilities.psmct32: Uses the older GS swizzle/alpha path; not covered by the indexed layout comparison. The 43 corpus records have a file body eight bytes shorter than their declared pixel extent and remain raw.
capabilities.graphics_workspace: The workspace indexes all 30,397 catalogued TXCs: 28,940 standalone archive leaves and 1,457 menu-bundle members. It exports 30,354 rasters directly inside flat semantic category directories: 27,316 PSMT4, 1,654 PSMT8, 677 PSMT8H, 690 PSMT4HL, and 17 PSMT4HH. Stable source IDs prevent collisions and index.json preserves original paths and hashes. Japanese baselines are not overwritten; 43 short PSMCT32 records remain raw.
capabilities.english_overrides: Every untouched exported baseline is named *_jp.tga and is preserved; an adjacent *_eng.tga is the editable localized variant selected for the English mod ISO. Same dimensions and source palette are required.

verification.synthetic: PSMT4/PSMT8/PSMT8H/PSMT4HL/PSMT4HH/PSMCT32 TGA export/import tests; unchanged files remain byte-identical; same-size indexed pixel edits retain the original mode and decode as expected
verification.real_samples: One PSMT8 512x512 and one PSMT4 128x128 game TXC export/import to TGA without edits and remain byte-identical
verification.container: Synthetic English TXC overrides reinsert through both nested UI-table/BPE/PAC and standalone-TXC/PAC paths; extracted source sidecars remain unchanged.
verification.visual_layout_samples: Controlled four-way image matrix for 10 PSMT8 and 10 PSMT4 TXCs favored linear pixel order; owner selected the mapped-linear title image. See reports/rtx3_layout_diagnostics.json.
verification.graphics_workspace: All 30,397 catalogued TXCs are indexed (28,940 standalone archive leaves plus 1,457 nested menu members). 30,354 images exported: 27,316 PSMT4, 1,654 PSMT8, 677 PSMT8H, 690 PSMT4HL, and 17 PSMT4HH. The full source-hash/TGA-dimension audit passed with zero edited Japanese baselines and zero English variants at audit time; 43 short PSMCT32 payloads remain indexed with explicit reasons.
verification.english_override: Synthetic *_eng.tga selected during staging and reinserted through both nested UI-table/BPE/PAC and standalone TXC/PAC paths; original Japanese TGA and extracted TXC sidecars remain unchanged.

limits: The controlled 20-resource PSMT4/PSMT8 visual comparison and three high-bit sample previews do not establish full-corpus layout or game runtime behavior.
AT animation, atlas regions, UV coordinates and final screen composition remain uninterpreted.
No English graphic has been runtime-validated yet.
No indexed palette creation or canvas resizing is supported. The 43 PSMCT32 files are short by eight pixel bytes relative to the declared extent and remain raw.
